description:
Tell Checkbox facts you found in the codebase or changes you made: site_url, checkout_url, policy URLs (Checkbox fetches and checks the Terms, refund and cancellation policies), billing_platform, plans and prices, project.layout_file, where checkout sessions are created, and which file got the snippet.
Facts decide which laws apply (free trials, annual terms, physical goods). Only send what you know; omit the rest.
Returns the updated checklist with next_action. Typical next step: get_setup_status with verify=true.

account_url.description: Account page where subscribers manage / cancel (null clears a URL).

cancellation_url.description: Separate cancellation policy page, if not in the Terms. Not where people cancel (account_url).

env_written.description: File you wrote the keys to, e.g. ".env.local".

live_site.description: Live-mode site id (site_…) if you created one with a live key.

merchant_name.description: The brand subscribers know (names the seller in generated disclosures), e.g. from the <title> or package.json Default: the host name, which the plan asks you to replace.

plans.description: Plans and prices in the code, e.g. [{"name":"Pro","amount":1900,"interval":"month","trial_days":14}]; a promo adds intro_percent_off and intro_periods. They decide which laws apply.

project.description: Facts about the codebase that help Checkbox point tasks at exact files.

checkout_code.description: Where Stripe Checkout Sessions / payment links are created, e.g. [{"file":"app/api/checkout/route.ts","line":12,"kind":"stripe_checkout_session"}].

kind.description: Required: stripe_checkout_session, stripe_payment_link, stripe_pricing_table, stripe_elements, subscribe_button, shopify_checkout…

framework.description: nextjs-app, nextjs-pages, remix, sveltekit, nuxt, astro, express, html, shopify-theme…

layout_file.description: Root layout / template where the snippet belongs, e.g. "app/layout.tsx".

pay_buttons.description: Where the subscribe / pay buttons are rendered.

refetch_policies.description: Fetch the policy pages again even if their URLs did not change (after editing them).

setup_session.description: Setup session id (setup_…). Default: the newest one.

site_url.description: Public URL of the site (production or a preview), e.g. "https://acme.example".

snippet_installed_in.description: File(s) you added the Checkbox snippet tag to, e.g. "app/layout.tsx".

terms_url.description: Terms of service URL. Checkbox fetches and checks it.

name: update_setup
title: Report what you learned or changed during setup
